status: Finance now owns a native draft goods-journal handoff for a future Commerce sales delivery. The Commerce goods-fulfillment command is not wired yet, so sales/orders and sales/fulfillment remain partial; this is a required owner prerequisite, not a workflow closure.

scope.api: post_commerce_goods_journal persists one deterministic draft delivery journal on the caller's serializable transaction. It resolves the open period, validates chart/accounts/base currency through the canonical journal preparation, writes two balanced lines (cost-of-sales debit, inventory credit) in the stock currency, binds source_type=delivery and source_id=fulfillment, and returns the journal id. A same-source replay returns the existing draft; a changed identity conflicts.
scope.boundary: The caller retains the Commerce order/fulfillment, Inventory stock issue and command receipt. Posting/GL review remains the existing Finance journal workflow; this adapter never posts.
